jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Climate
jobs.description: About Flexport:  At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.  The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us. Why Climate Matters More Than Ever Supply chain leaders are being asked to cut costs and carbon at the same time. Yet logistics and sustainability teams often work with different data, tools, and priorities. Meanwhile, regulations and industry standards are raising expectations for how companies measure and manage their emissions. Most climate tools stop at reporting: a dashboard or a year-end PDF, produced long after a shipment has moved. They rarely reach the people deciding how to route goods, when to ship, or how much inventory to hold. The Climate team at Flexport is building emissions intelligence directly into the platform where supply chain decisions are made. We help customers weigh cost, speed, and emissions together—and turn that understanding into action. The Opportunity Flexport already runs the shipments, holds the data, and provides the platform where customers manage their supply chains. That puts us in a strong position to connect climate insights with the operational decisions that drive emissions. Our uniquely redesigned product delivers a significantly more compact fuel cell system with high power density and lower production costs. jobs.title: Senior Stack Scientist
jobs.description: Senior Stack Scientist About EH Energy Engineering EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy. As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance. Key Responsibilities Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks. Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles. Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance. Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams. Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies. Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production. Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression. Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners. Skills and Experience Required PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field. 12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred). Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management,

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière. Notre vision Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes. Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients. À propos de Pennylane Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen. En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à : 💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant 💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches! 🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible 🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours 🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expe

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description: Running a frontline business is an operational puzzle most software has never touched. Shift-by-shift labour costs, compliance that changes by region and by role, and margins thin enough that a badly built rota can sink a quarter. It's a harder problem than most white-collar SaaS, and yet frontline sectors employ 80% of the global workforce and have received about 1% of the last decade's software investment. We think AI is what makes the problem solvable; better software alone wasn't enough. Frontline organisations sit on enormous amounts of operational data. Used properly, that data lets agents take on real parts of running the business rather than just reporting on it. That's what we're building at Sona, and it's early enough that the systems you build now will still be foundational in three years. We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here . About the Role Sona's Customer Success function is being built from the ground up. $Millions of ARR is moving from Implementation to Customer Success, we're heading into our first year of renewals at scale, and there's meaningful seat expansion across the base. We need CSMs who can shape what good looks like, not operate inside a playbook someone else wrote. You'll own a book of around 20-25 enterprise accounts across social care, hospitality and retail, partnering with Support, Product and Sales to own the post-live customer experience end to end. Some of the accounts you'll inherit are in difficult places, so you'll be rebuilding trust, holding rooms independently and driving outcomes in ambiguity. We're a high-performance team. Everyone holds an important seat and is expected to perform at an elite level. We have each other's backs, we assume good intent, and we have zero space for internal politics. jobs.title: Controls Engineer
jobs.description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Robotics Team The Robotics team is responsible for bridging the gap from our model to our vehicle platforms, in order to let the model focus on making driving decisions. We aim to provide high quality data to the model for making such decisions, whilst abstracting away platform-specific aspects. We combine specialisms across the robotics domain, blending strong theoretical foundations with solid engineering practice to span the spectrum from research to production. 🧠 Your day-to-day Develop, integrate, tune, and validate control, trajectory-generation, and action-processing algorithms across different vehicle platforms, operating modes, and challenging driving conditions, ensuring robust real-world performance Maintain and evolve our controls software architecture that connects AI Driver outputs to real-time vehicle actuation and feedback Own requirements, release readiness, and in-field performance and issue triage Implement and maintain production-quality, latency-sensitive control software in C++ for deployment to prototype, reference and production vehicles Use simulation, closed-loop evaluation and on-road testing to characterize controller behaviour, diagnose performance issues and validate improvements Work with teams across Wayve to define controller interfaces, integrate with adjacent systems and enable new vehicle platforms and product features (Ownership through the full lifecycle) Define and track quality metrics (e.g., comfort, tracking error, and safety margin KPIs, and regressions against them) Contribute to safety artefacts: provide evidence for safety cases, work with the safety team to ensure compliance with required

jobs.title: Senior Delivery Recruiter Tech (m/w/d), 180° Delivery, 100 % Remote
jobs.description: Die meisten Recruiter sind Postboten. Wir nicht. Die Branche ist kaputt. Hunderte Kandidaten werden angespammt, CVs blind rausgeschickt, und dann wird gebetet. Das Ergebnis sind genervte Kunden, verbrannte Talente und Placement-Quoten zum Weinen. Bei Recruitment Circle machen wir Delivery anders: mit Daten, Psychologie und einem Auswahlverfahren, das Blender aussortiert, bevor der Kunde sie sieht. Das Ergebnis: 7 von 10 Kandidaten, die wir einreichen, landen im Interview. Der Markt liegt bei 10–20 %. Dein Job: reines Delivery. Du bekommst die Mandate. Du lieferst die Menschen. Punkt. Dein Erfolg wird an Placements gemessen, nicht an Stunden: Monat 1: Du steuerst die Prozesse eines Key-Accounts eigenständig. Monat 2: Deine erste Vermittlung ist durch. Monat 6: Du hast 60.000 € Umsatz geliefert. Monat 12: Du stehst bei 250.000 € Jahresumsatz und bist eine Bank in der Delivery. Was du mitbringst 3+ Jahre Agentur-Recruiting , idealerweise bei einem kleineren Personaldienstleister. Du weißt, was Dienstleistung heißt. Sourcing-Skills: LinkedIn Recruiter, Xing, GitHub, Stack Overflow, und Lust auf neue Tools wie Juicebox und Clay. Du findest die passiven Talente, die sonst keiner erreicht. Biss im Interview: Du bohrst nach, bis die echte Performance auf dem Tisch liegt. Augenhöhe: Du sprichst mit CTOs und Practice Leads als Experte, nicht als Bittsteller. Extreme Ownership: Bei dir fällt nichts runter. Ein schweres Profil ist für dich eine Challenge, kein Grund zu jammern. Was du bekommst Geld, das Leistung abbildet: 50–60k Fix, 5–20 % Provision ab dem ersten Euro, 100k+ OTE für alle, die liefern. 100 % Remote, deutschlandweit: Kein Pendeln, keine Präsenzpflicht. Tech-Stack, der arbeitet: Recruit CRM, Apollo, Clay, Juicebox und eigene Automatisierungs-Workflows. Wir bauen die Maschine, du bedienst die Hebel. RC-Masterclass: Du lernst, Lebensläufe zu sezieren und A-Player von Blendern zu trennen Zeitnah verfügbar? Umso besser. Schick uns dein LinkedIn-Profil und deine Place

jobs.title: Junior Projektsteuerer / Junior Projektmanager für Pflege- und Seniorenimmobilien (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Unser Unternehmen In Deutschland wächst der Bedarf an hochwertigen und innovativen Wohn- und Pflegekonzepten für Senior*innen stetig – und wir gestalten diesen Wandel aktiv mit. Als inhabergeführtes Investment- und Projektentwicklungsunternehmen schaffen wir zukunftsorientierte Pflege- und Servicewohnanlagen, die Lebensqualität und moderne Infrastruktur verbinden. Als Junior Projektsteuerer / Junior Projektmanager kannst Du dabei Dein technisches Know-how einbringen, Neubau- und Sanierungsprojekte von der Planung bis zur baulichen Umsetzung begleiten und Schritt für Schritt Verantwortung im Projekt übernehmen. Gestalte mit uns Wohn- und Pflegekonzepte von morgen und trage dazu bei, sichere, moderne und lebenswerte Immobilien für ältere Menschen zu schaffen. jobs.description: Über die IB.SH Die Investitionsbank Schleswig-Holstein (IB.SH) ist das zentrale Förderinstitut des Landes. Rund 900 Menschen sorgen in Kiel dafür, dass Wohnungsbau, Unternehmen, Kommunen, Bildung sowie Umwelt- und Energieprojekte in Schleswig-Holstein vorankommen. Gerade läuft eine der größten Transformationen in der Geschichte der Bank. Die gesamte SAP-Landschaft zieht auf S/4HANA um, die Private-Cloud-Umgebung steht bereits, und bis Ende 2027 soll das neue System produktiv sein. Für diese Phase sucht die IB.SH Verstärkung im SAP-Team: eine:n SAP-Entwickler:in (w/m/d) mit Schwerpunkt ABAP, Batch-Verarbeitung und Schnittstellen . Du arbeitest in einem vierköpfigen Team, das eng mit drei weiteren SAP-Teams zusammenarbeitet. Bei der IB.SH gibt es keine Trennung zwischen Beratung und Entwicklung, du begleitest deine Themen also vom ersten Gespräch mit dem Fachbereich bis zum laufenden Betrieb. Deine Aufgaben Du baust das, was nachts läuft, und sorgst dafür, dass die Bank am nächsten Morgen damit arbeiten kann. Du entwickelst SAP-Lösungen in ABAP und ABAP-OO, von der ersten Idee über Prototypen bis zur produktiven Anwendung. Du steuerst und optimierst die Batch-Verarbeitung, planst Jobabläufe und überführst Anwendungen in die Hintergrundverarbeitung. Du betreust Schnittstellen rund um Zahlungsverkehr, Korrespondenz, FICO und die Schufa-Anbindung sowie zu den bankfachlichen SAP-Modulen. Du bearbeitest IT-Changes und Störungen eigenverantwortlich, von der Analyse über Tests bis zur Freigabe. Du berätst die Fachbereiche der Bank, nimmst Anforderungen auf und übersetzt sie in technische Lösungen. Du gestaltest die Umstellung auf S/4HANA aktiv mit und bringst deine Erfahrung in Projekte ein. Was du mitbringst Du bist ein IT-Mensch durch und durch, arbeitest aber nicht still im Hintergrund, sondern gern im Austausch mit den Menschen, für die du entwickelst. Must-haves Ein Studium oder eine Ausbildung im IT-Umfeld, oder einen vergleichbaren Weg in die IT Mehrjährige Erfahrung

jobs.title: Head of Product - Personal Banking
jobs.description: In 1967, John Shepherd-Barron reached his bank minutes after closing and could not get at his own money. In the bath that evening, he thought of a chocolate bar dispenser and swapped the chocolate for cash. On 27 June, outside a Barclays branch on Enfield High Street, an actor named Reg Varney drew £10 from the world's first cash machine. It took a four-digit code (originally six, until his wife told him nobody remembers six). The bank's hours had stopped being the customer's problem. Nearly sixty years later, the bar has moved, but the test hasn't: a personal financial product is judged on whether it fits the life of the person using it. People do not read documentation, forgive a confusing screen, or care how the ledger works. They want one place that makes sense of everything — spending, saving, planning, investing — and that anticipates rather than reports: where they stand, what deserves attention, what to do next. Mercury is building personal banking* to that standard. Personal Banking is how Mercury earns a place in someone's financial life. We're looking for a Head of Product to own it end-to-end: setting product strategy, leading a team of product managers, driving growth and engagement, and owning business performance. *Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC. jobs.title: Head of Product - Business Banking
jobs.description: In 1851, a New York bookkeeper named George D. Lyman observed the same absurd ritual each afternoon: porters carried bags of coins and bundles of checks bank to bank down Wall Street, settling by hand, a fortune exposed to error and theft. Lyman's fix: send everything through one central office and settle the net. On October 11, 1853, in the basement of 14 Wall Street, 52 banks cleared $22.6 million in a single sitting. Money between banks had stopped being an event and became seamless infrastructure. A century and a half later, the hard part is unchanged: moving money once is easy; making it work every time, for hundreds of thousands of businesses, across every rail, is hard. The bank account is where a company's financial life happens - payroll clears or it doesn't; a wire lands or a deal slips; the month closes clean, or someone loses a weekend to it. Mercury is building a business banking* product at a scale better than anything else in the market. Business Banking is the heart of Mercury. We're looking for a Head of Product to own it end-to-end: setting product strategy, leading a team of product managers, driving deposit and payment growth, and owning business performance. *Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Dan is dit misschien wel jouw volgende stap. Premium hoorzorg, zoals het bedoeld is Binnen onze zelfstandige optiekwinkels staat persoonlijke aandacht centraal. Onze klanten kennen ons vanwege onze deskundigheid, kwaliteit en service. Diezelfde benadering willen we verder uitbouwen binnen horen. Daarom zoeken we een audicien die samen met ons wil bouwen aan een sterke audiotak. Afhankelijk van de situatie gaat het om het verder ontwikkelen van een bestaande klantenkring of het opbouwen van een nieuwe activiteit binnen een winkel waar al een vertrouwde klantenbasis aanwezig is. Je krijgt daarbij de ruimte om je vak uit te oefenen zoals jij vindt dat goede hoorzorg hoort te zijn: met tijd voor de klant, persoonlijke aandacht en premium hooroplossingen. Wat maakt deze functie anders? Je werkt in een professionele, persoonlijke omgeving waar niet de snelle verkoop, maar de beste oplossing voor de klant centraal staat. Je kunt rekenen op: · Premium hooroplossingen · Ruim voldoende tijd en aandacht voor iedere klant · Een bestaand klantenbestand vanuit de optiek · Warme leads via onze partner Audibene · Professionele ondersteuning en coaching vanuit de organisatie · Ruimte voor jouw ideeën en vakmanschap · De kans om daadwerkelijk mee te bouwen aan de audiotak · Dagen en uren in overleg, met aandacht voor een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé Voor wie is dit een mooie stap? Misschien werk je nu bij een grotere keten en zoek je meer persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en betrokkenheid. Of je bent toe aan een omgeving waarin je niet alleen audicien bent, maar ook kunt meedenken over hoe we de beste hoorzorg voor onze klanten organiseren. Ruime ervaring is voor ons niet het belan

As a  Platform Engineer , you’ll work at the intersection of development, infrastructure, and operations. Build a self-service developer platform with a particular emphasis on developer experience, designing and maintaining platforms that abstract complexity and give teams the tools to deploy, monitor, and optimise their applications. jobs.description: About AIM Intelligent Machines AIM Intelligent Machines is pioneering the future of heavy equipment automation. Our technology enables a single operator to monitor and control multiple machines simultaneously—dramatically improving productivity, reducing labor costs, and reshaping what's possible in construction, mining, and industrial operations. Through cutting-edge AI, computer vision, and robotics, AIM is solving critical challenges in equipment autonomy and remote operations. We're building systems that augment human capability—allowing people to do more with less, safely and efficiently. We are growing quickly and looking for experienced, motivated Account Managers to accelerate adoption of our solutions by building strong partnerships and cultivating strategic customer relationships. Position Summary As Dealer Account Manager, you will play a pivotal role in scaling AIM’s groundbreaking heavy equipment automation platform. You’ll be responsible for growing revenue through both channel partners and direct key accounts, with a clear focus on companies looking to deploy machine automation that allows one operator to manage fleets of equipment. You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams—including sales leadership, product, and engineering—to help customers modernize their operations and gain a competitive edge through AIM’s autonomous systems. Enable and train partners to sell AIM solutions focused on multi-machine control and operator augmentation. Monitor partner performance and support business planning to meet joint sales targets. Identify new partners in strategic markets (construction, mining, landfill and quarry environments. jobs.title: Country Manager - Germany (Shift)
jobs.description: Accelerating embodied AGI. The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century. microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data. We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries. This is an incredible opportunity, to own Shift’s German operation, from business acquisition and data collection through logistics, team-building and delivery. Requirements Strong operational ownership: able to make local decisions, coordinate teams and take responsibility for delivery. Ability to win participation from businesses, particularly mid-sized businesses doing skilled, non-domestic tasks. Commercial judgment: build a local operation while operating as lean as possible. Practical logistics capability: maximise hardware, including distribution, returns, cleaning, uploads and loss prevention. Comfort building a team where justified by the economics, while working closely with Shift’s central team. Willingness to do hands-on, repetitive operational work, not only strategy or automation. Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations. jobs.description: About the Team Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes directly to our mission of responsible and widespread AI adoption. Our opportunity spans major enterprises and digital natives, ambitious startups, developers, partners, and a highly influential business community navigating the adoption of AI. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: About us Encord is the universal data layer for AI that helps 300+ AI teams train and run models on the right data. Our platform indexes, curates, annotates, and evaluates data across the full AI lifecycle, from development through production. Trusted by Woven by Toyota, AXA, UiPath, Zipline, and more. We're an ambitious team of 100+ working at the frontier of AI and have raised $60M in Series C funding from Wellington Management, CRV, Next47 and Y Combinator. The role We're looking for a Senior ML Systems Engineer to join Encord's in-house ML team. This is a software-engineering-first role for someone with real machine learning deployment experience: you'll design, build and run the infrastructure that serves our computer vision and multimodal models in production. Our platform is moving from manual, GUI-heavy annotation towards ML-driven workflows, where models do more of the work and learn from annotator feedback. Your job is to make that possible by turning our models into fast, dependable product features. Our ML team covers both research and engineering, and this role sits firmly on the engineering side. You'll own architecture, implementation, deployment and production operations, while teammates on the research side focus on longer-horizon experiments and prototypes. Day-to-day, you'll work closely with them, as well as with our Product Engineering and Human Data teams. Problems you'll work on Interactive inference in the annotation editor. Serving heavy vision and multimodal models fast enough that annotators get model suggestions in real time, with their corrections flowing back as feedback. Inference at very large scale. Pre-computing model outputs across millions of hours of egocentric video for robotics customers, where throughput, GPU cost and reliability all matter. Taking agentic QC to production. Turning quality-control agents that check multimodal outputs against a customer's ontology from a research prototype into a dependable platform feature. On

jobs.title: ML Researcher
jobs.description: About Us Base Compute is an AI inference lab. Our mission is to bring AGI on device. We believe in a world where everyone has access to intelligence: fast, private and always available on your device. We’re building the infrastructure for the next generation of on-device AI, from silicon-level optimizations to distributed inference systems. We’re working on hard problems at the intersection of inference efficiency, model intelligence and autonomous research. The Role We’re looking for a Founding ML Researcher to work at the frontier of on-device AI. This role is for someone who identifies problems and potentials, designs and executes experiments and derives insights that translate into real-world performance. You’ll have significant ownership over our research agenda and direct influence on the technical bets the company makes. jobs.title: Internship: Explainable AI for the qualification of aerospace algorithms
jobs.description: Background Machine learning is increasingly used in aerospace for tasks that have traditionally relied on human experts or on fixed rule-based procedures. For such tasks, data-driven algorithms promise gains in speed, consistency and sensitivity. Before they can be used in practice however, they must be qualified, which means it has to be demonstrated with sufficient substantiation that the algorithm performs its intended function reliably within a defined set of conditions. The qualification approaches used in the sector today were developed for human operators and for conventional systems whose behaviour can be traced back to explicit requirements. They do not translate directly to algorithms whose behaviour is learned from data, and emerging guidance from aviation authorities names explainability as a key ingredient of trustworthy AI, while leaving open how it should be demonstrated in practice. Performance figures on a test set do not show why an algorithm reaches a decision, whether it relies on physically meaningful information, or how it behaves outside the data it was trained on. Explainable machine learning offers a wide range of methods to address this, from feature attribution and saliency methods, to example-based and concept-based explanations, but it is still an open question which of these can provide evidence that is strong enough to support qualification. This project therefore investigates how explainability methods can contribute to the qualification of machine learning algorithms for aerospace, starting from an use case, and provides a comparative assessment of several methods. Assignment The assignment will include the following tasks: A literature study on the qualification of machine learning algorithms in safety-critical sectors and on explainability methods for machine learning (e.g., attribution and saliency methods, example-based and concept-based explanations, interpretable models, uncertainty quantification), including the ways in which

jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer — Agent Platform (all genders)
jobs.description: wingmaite captures the knowledge companies never write down: who decides what, how work actually gets done, and why decisions were made. Our AI agents use that knowledge to answer questions and get work done. We're looking for a Staff engineer to own the technical quality and direction of our agent platform. You'll build features end to end, from the agent into the backend. You won't manage people. You'll work closely with our CTO as a technical sparring partner. What You'll Do Design the agents: Decide how our agents plan, use tools and handle multi-step work, and where people need to step in. Build reusable components so each new use case doesn't need its own system. Connect agents to company knowledge: Build how that knowledge reaches the agents, together with the people who decide what it should contain. Make answers reliable: Agents should be correct, cite their sources, show people only what they're allowed to see, and know when not to act. Track quality: Build evals, monitor quality and cost, and keep our model choices up to date. Ship end to end: Build features from the agent through to the backend yourself. Keep the architecture consistent: Set the patterns others build on, document decisions, keep specs current, and review designs with engineering, product and design. How We Work We build features as one team: design, product, engineering and AI together, from the first idea to production. You'll help shape a feature while it's still a problem and stay with it until it works for users. Agents depend on the knowledge behind them, so we build both as one system. We write decisions down and discuss disagreements openly. What This Role Is Not A management role, a prompt-engineering role, or an infrastructure or security role. What We're Looking For Must-Haves You've shipped multi-step, tool-using LLM agents to production (LangGraph or similar) You know when sub-agents help, how to build good evals, and why retrieval fails Fluent in Python and productive in Typ

jobs.title: Art Director Performance Creatives (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Wir sind eine Performance Marketing Agentur mit einem großen Fokus auf Creative Design. Wir entwickeln datengetriebene Ad Creatives, Creative Strategien und skalierbare Produktionsprozesse für Social Ads, vor allem auf Meta und TikTok, und produzieren dabei über 1.000 Creatives im Monat. Kurz zur Einordnung, weil der Begriff Performance Creatives oft ein bisschen unklar ist: Damit meinen wir ganz einfach Werbeanzeigen für Social Media, also Bilder, Videos und UGC Ads für Instagram, Facebook und TikTok. Für YouTube erstellen wir die auch, unser größter Fokus liegt aber ganz klar auf Meta Ads (Instagram und Facebook) und TikTok Ads. Dabei arbeiten wir mit richtig großen Playern zusammen und begleiten sie strategisch, zum Beispiel Nivea, Sixt, Shop Apotheke, mymuesli, Steiff, Gothaer, Finanzguru, Pixum und Olavson. Jetzt suchen wir einen Art Director in Vollzeit, der bei uns die kreative und strategische Leitung übernimmt. Das ist für uns eine extrem wichtige Rolle. Du entwickelst nicht einfach schöne Designs, du entwickelst Creative Strategien, die auf Research und Daten basieren, bist ganz nah an unseren Kunden dran, bereitest Reportings auf und leitest unser Design Team. Beim Thema AI sind wir extrem weit vorne. Unser Setup basiert auf Claude, Figma und Higgsfield, nicht auf Adobe, und wir setzen einfach viel daran, jedem im Team richtig gute AI Prozesse an die Hand zu geben. Du kannst bei uns also super viel lernen. Wichtig ist nur, dass du in diesen Tools wirklich selbstständig arbeiten kannst. Genau deshalb arbeiten wir zielbasiert und nicht nach Zeit. Flexible Arbeitszeiten sind bei uns ganz normal, und wenn du es schaffst, deine Prozesse smart zu optimieren, hast du neben dem Job auch einfach ein richtig gutes Leben. Aufgaben Strategie: Du entwickelst Creative Strategien für unsere Kunden. Der Kunde schickt eine Kampagne, du arbeitest die Strategie dahinter aus, inklusive Kampagnenkonzept, Angles, Testing Ansätzen und Messaging Research: Du tauchst richtig tief

jobs.title: Founding ML Engineer (Spectrum)
jobs.description: Software engineers and AI agents alike suffer from the same problem: finding that one person or place that will answer their tough, specific question. Many solutions promise to solve this with similarity search in vector databases. Unfortunately, finding the answer is often a puzzle with pieces to be collected across a myriad of contradictory sources and cannot be solved without surgical search and careful reasoning.  Spectrum collects data from an organization’s code, docs, and issues, and organizes knowledge in a unified ontology that AI agents can efficiently search through and reason over. jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.
